expectations.text: Findings are evaluated mobile-first, since 74% of spend lands on mobile.
expectations.evidence: Mobile awareness appears but is partial and not the evaluative frame. The 74% figure is cited once, and only in the deprioritized section ('Since mobile is 74% of spend, this is your biggest conversion leak'), to justify seeking dev budget for LCP. Item 3 references '5.2s LCP' and item 5 adds a mobile preview caveat ('preview it on mobile after moving it'), but that is layout QA, not mobile-first prioritization.
